purpose: Per-file sha256 pins for the 8 bundled deck templates the ppt engine offers when a task brings no template of its own. The pins are the tracked truth; the .pptx payload stays out of git (see the destination directory's .gitignore) and out of PRs: it is hosted as a generic package in the project's GitLab package registry and rides the built ppt-engine wheel as package data.

endpoint.package: ppt-templates 2026.09.03, generic package registry of gitlab.com/npc-work/aic/ai/raven (project 84258686)
endpoint.auth: the project is private: fetch_templates.py sends PRIVATE-TOKEN from $GITLAB_TOKEN (any token that can read the repository), or JOB-TOKEN from $CI_JOB_TOKEN inside CI
endpoint.owner: maintainer + raven-ppt product team, jointly (ppt verdict C4)
endpoint.note: a new template cut is a new package version: upload the files, rewrite the pins, bump this url; the old version stays downloadable for older checkouts

source_of_truth: GitLab generic package ppt-templates/2026.09.03 (project 84258686): the eight re-cut templates this branch bundles; the retired fork kept its own twelve and was never the payload (its record: git history at the subagents/ removal commit)
